name: jevify
description: Find the line that explains a failure, check a statement against a text, or pick the item a description means. Selects, never generates.
long_description: jevify points at the right thing among real things, with a confidence score and an honest "nothing fits". Tools: `why` (the root-cause line of a failed build, test or CI log, from a path or the text), `is` (a yes, no or unsure verdict on one statement about a text) and `pick` (the one item a description means, among supplied items or the commits, branches, files, PRs, CI runs or installed tools of a directory). `pick` selects and starts no command. Every result carries jevify's JSON envelope as structuredContent; exit_code 3 is an abstention with the nearest candidates in data.shortlist. Without a key, jevify answers through classifier.dev's free budget; a TypeSafe key file uses your own quota. Evidence leaves the machine; see PRIVACY.md.

tools.name: why
tools.description: Point at the line that states the root cause in a failed build, test or CI log, from a path or the text.

tools.name: is
tools.description: Answer yes, no or unsure to one literal statement about a text.

tools.name: pick
tools.description: Select the one item a description means, among supplied items or the real commits, branches, files, PRs, CI runs or installed tools of a directory; selects only.

key_file.title: TypeSafe key file
key_file.description: A file holding your TypeSafe API key, read by jevify and never printed. Leave it empty to run keyless through classifier.dev's free budget.
